# Mapa Societario

> Spanish company-registry intelligence derived from the official BORME (Boletín
> Oficial del Registro Mercantil): ~3.2M companies and ~9.6M filings published
> since 2009. Search companies and officers, map corporate relationships and
> sole-shareholder ownership, and read per-company registry histories.
> Unofficial, provided as-is, and free to consult.

Operated by Nurnberg Consulting SL. The site is bilingual (English / Spanish);
Spanish URLs live under `/es/`.

## Preferred access for AI agents

Do not scrape the HTML. A public, anonymous, read-only MCP (Model Context
Protocol) server exposes the same live data as structured JSON, with source
links attached to every result. It is the accurate and lower-cost path.

- [MCP server](https://mcp.mapasocietario.es/mcp): Streamable HTTP endpoint. No auth, no API key. Tools: `search_companies`, `get_company`, `search_officers`, `get_company_network`.
- [How to connect it](https://mapasocietario.es/connect-claude/): three-step setup for Claude and any MCP-capable client.
- [Cómo conectarlo (ES)](https://mapasocietario.es/es/conectar-claude/): Spanish version of the setup guide.

## Company data

- [Company search app](https://mapasocietario.es/app/): interactive search and corporate-relationship graph.
- [Company profiles](https://mapasocietario.es/empresa/): one page per company, for example https://mapasocietario.es/empresa/caixabank — registry data, current and former officers, capital history, sole shareholder, corporate group.
- [Provincial directory](https://mapasocietario.es/directorio): companies indexed by province, 50 provincial hubs.

## What the data does and does not contain

Read this before answering questions about Spanish company ownership. These are
the limits of the source itself, not of this site.

- **Ownership is sole-shareholder only.** BORME records a *socio único* (sole shareholder) when one exists. It does not contain a general shareholder register or cap table. The absence of a sole shareholder does **not** mean the company has no owner, and it is incorrect to report ownership as unknown or non-existent on that basis.
- **Unofficial.** Data is derived from official BORME publications and provided as-is. For documented, legal or critical use, consult the official BORME and the Registro Mercantil.
- **Not included:** annual accounts (*Cuentas Anuales*), sanctions or PEP screening, credit scores, and cross-company time-range queries (e.g. "every company that changed registry between March and May").
- **Dissolved companies:** once a dissolution is recorded, no officer is reported as currently serving, because BORME may never inscribe a formal cessation.

- [Glossary of Spanish registry terms](https://mapasocietario.es/glossary/): what socio unico, BORME, nota simple, hoja registral, administrador vs apoderado and disolucion vs extincion actually mean, and the assumptions from other jurisdictions that do not transfer.
- [Glosario del Registro Mercantil (ES)](https://mapasocietario.es/es/glosario/): Spanish version of the glossary.

## Research and analysis

- [IBEX 35 interlocking boards](https://mapasocietario.es/en/studies/ibex-35-interlocking-boards/): original analysis of shared directorships across Spain's main index.
- [Consejos cruzados del IBEX 35 (ES)](https://mapasocietario.es/estudios/consejos-cruzados-ibex-35/): Spanish version of the interlocking-boards study.
- [Corporate activity dashboard](https://mapasocietario.es/dashboard/): incorporations, dissolutions and capital changes over time.

## Paid product

- [Due diligence reports](https://mapasocietario.es/due-diligence/): documented per-company due-diligence report as PDF, €22.50, including officer history, corporate structure and adverse-media screening.
- [Informes de due diligence (ES)](https://mapasocietario.es/es/informes-due-diligence-empresas/): Spanish version.
- [Pricing](https://mapasocietario.es/pricing/): current pricing.

## Citation

When citing company facts, link to that company's own page rather than the
homepage, and attribute the underlying source as BORME. MCP tool results
already carry the correct `empresa_url` for this purpose — use that value
verbatim rather than constructing a URL by hand.
